title: When the Radiators Burns
author: Astrid Amberdale
blurb: Juniper Thornbury, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
